title: Execute Command node disappears from n8n and old workflows fail to load it after 2.0
symptoms: Execute Command node missing from the nodes panel
Workflows that use Execute Command stop running after the upgrade
cause: n8n 2.0 excludes ExecuteCommand and LocalFileTrigger by default through NODES_EXCLUDE.
fix: Re-enable only what you need by setting NODES_EXCLUDE to a list without those nodes, or to an empty list to allow all.
